name: lib/data-legacy
description: The older answer to data: the pre-generic collections (DataLists/Queues/Stacks/Trees, TFClasses), persistence (PersistentObjects, PrevalenceSystem, DataIO), and the SQL/ODBC bindings.
residual: Split out of std/data on 2026-08-27 by the Rust border (docs/STDLIB.md): the standard library keeps what packages talk to each other through, and these are leaves ob get can deliver. Sources still live in source/; `headless` false keeps them out of the SDK payload.
CSV passed through on 2026-08-27 and went back to std/encoding: the SDK's own suite tests it (tests/CSV.Test), so the payload has to carry it.
